title: Auto Loans: Number of Loans a Borrower May Hold
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank lets one customer carry more than one Auto Loans account, within two holding limits and one bar on new applications.

## Rule

1. **Portfolio limit.** A new application is recorded only while the customer's auto loans that are applied for, active or delinquent number fewer than 3.
2. **Product limit.** Among those same statuses, the customer's loans of the product now being requested must number fewer than the per-product holding limit set for that product.
3. **Charge-off bar.** A customer any of whose auto loans stands charged off may not apply at all.
4. **Loans that are not counted.** Loans that are paid off and applications that were withdrawn fall outside both counts.

Each limit is read from the bank's own loan records for that customer at the moment the application would be recorded; what the customer says about their other loans does not replace those records.

## Which statuses count

| Loan status on the customer's records | Counts toward the limit of 3 | Counts toward the product limit | Effect on a new application |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applied (pending) | yes | yes, if the same product | none beyond the count |
| Active | yes | yes, if the same product | none beyond the count |
| Delinquent | yes | yes, if the same product | none beyond the count |
| Paid off | no | no | none |
| Withdrawn | no | no | none |
| Charged off | not a counting question | not a counting question | no application may be recorded |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical customers)

- A customer with one active and one delinquent loan, plus two paid-off loans, has a count of 2, which is fewer than 3; the portfolio limit allows the application, and the product limit still has to be read for the product requested.
- A customer with two active loans and one pending application has a count of 3; because the count must be fewer than 3, the application is not recorded.
- A customer whose only other auto loan was charged off years ago, and who has no counted loans, still cannot apply, since the bar looks at any charged-off auto loan.
